conversations_memory:
**Work context**

Ranveer Kumar is an 18-year-old solo founder from Jharkhand, India running two ventures: Whiteroom, a privacy-first school management platform (DPDP Act 2023 compliant) targeting India's 1.5M schools, and Apocalypto Labs, an AI automation agency using full-code LangChain/Python. He is also a JEE 2027 aspirant targeting NIT/IIIT.

**Personal context**

Ranveer is based in Chaibasa, Jharkhand, with strong interests in cybersecurity, AI/ML, and building technology. He built a 10M parameter LLM at 16 and a honeypot scam detection system with a team at the same age. He communicates in casual, fast-paced shorthand and prefers direct, actionable responses.

**Top of mind**

Whiteroom's pilot launch is set for August 13, 2026, with 5,300+ students pre-booked across 5 institutions through personal connections and zero paid acquisition. Remaining technical priorities before launch include original-quality uploads, CDN/chunked upload infrastructure, annual class promotion system, and billing engine updates. On the funding side, Ranveer has applied to a broad slate of investors and programs (YC, Accel Atoms, EF, Shark Tank Campus Special, Master Union Venture, Huddle Ventures, AJVC, 2am VC, Zeropearl, 888VC, a16z Speedrun) and is waiting for responses before applying further. LvlUp's investment committee is actively reviewing his fund application, and an Operating Snapshot form for LvlUp was due July 8.

**Brief history**

*Recent months*

Ranveer finalized Whiteroom's feature set and pricing architecture through extensive iteration: Free / ₹499 Basic / ₹999 Standard / Custom Enterprise, with global pricing planned (€29/€59 Europe, $29/$59 USA, $9/$19 SEA). The pitch narrative centers on "price for adoption, not revenue — moat is the network, monetization follows distribution." The tech stack is React Native (Expo) mobile, Hono backend, PostgreSQL via Supabase + Drizzle ORM, Firebase Phone Auth + FCM, pg-boss for jobs, and Railway hosting — with multi-tenant RLS, offline attendance sync, FCM absent notifications, T+0/T+5/T+60 reminders, sibling switcher, and DPDP consent logging. The MVP is fully built, security-audited (10 critical bugs fixed including a double OTP vulnerability), and pilot-ready. The website whiteroom.co.in is live (deployed on Vercel). A NotebookLM-generated pitch deck is the primary investor deck. Branding uses Navy #2F4156, Teal #567C8D, Sky Blue #C8D9E6, White; W+i ligature logo; Inter font; 34 screens planned with Batch 1 (6 auth screens) completed. SHOPLINE declined partnership citing early stage but left the door open post-pilot. Ranveer was confirmed for LvlUp's Power of the Pitch Day (virtual, 200+ investors including Alumni Ventures, Insight Partners, Antler, Fidelity). A GitHub profile README was built for username RABNEER. A 2-minute video script was drafted for EF's application. Technical University of Munich was mentioned as an alternative to IIT/NIT but deferred as a decision until post-pilot.

For Apocalypto Labs, Ranveer drafted a formal service agreement for a WhatsApp AI Agent deployment with a restaurant client (Vreehi), covering setup and monthly hosting fees. SEO work was done for Let's Click Photography Ranchi as a client engagement.

*Earlier context*

Ranveer participated in the Google Cloud Rapid Agent Hackathon (May–June 2026, ~13K participants, $60K prize pool). He selected the Elastic track and proposed an Autonomous SOC Analyst Agent (named ARGUS) that ingests security logs, triages alerts, correlates events, and auto-generates incident reports — building on his prior honeypot AI detection work. A fundraising rejection from Hustle Fund was received (geographic/structural reason: they invest only in Delaware C Corps in US/Canada/SEA); Claude advised focusing on India-focused investors already in pipeline and treating Delaware incorporation as a later-stage consideration.
